chunk_findings.detail: In `test_regenerate_warns_when_the_branch_is_behind_its_base`, the test asserts `assert "behind `main`" in (out.data.get("note") or "")`. However, `_behind_warning` determines the base using `DR.base_of(primary, repo, cfg)`. In a test repository initialized via standard test fixtures without an explicit base configured or set up according to `DR.base_of`'s expectations (such as upstream tracking or convention), `DR.base_of` may return a different branch name (like `master` or empty string) rather than `main`, causing the string assertion `"behind `main`"` to fail even if a warning is successfully attached.

chunk_findings.detail: `boundary="word"` runs after `whole_marks`, so a head that still contains a finished mark can be split on a space inside that mark and end on a partial `[REDACTED:...]`. Given `clip("[REDACTED:foo bar]END", 20, boundary="word")`, the size is 22, the 20-character head is `[REDACTED:foo bar]E` (mark still closed, so `whole_marks` keeps it), and `rsplit(" ", 1)[0]` returns `[REDACTED:foo`, which is exactly the cut the marker policy forbids.
